name: Giant Squid
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +3. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 16. Languages none.
appearance: A long rust-brown squid with a pointed mantle, curling arms and two longer, paddle-tipped tentacles.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, 2024-rules Monster Manual p. 360, printed folio facsimile, sheet 363. https://anyflip.com/acscv/ypya/mobile/index.html#p=363
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. The squid breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tentacle attack.
Bite. Melee attack roll +9, reach 5 ft. Hit for 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Tentacle. Melee attack roll +9, reach 15 ft. Hit for 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit gains the Grappled condition from one of the squid’s two tentacles, escape DC 16. The squid can pull that target up to 10 ft. straight toward itself.
sections.Reactions: Ink Cloud (1/Day). When the squid takes damage underwater, it fills a 15-ft. Cube centered on itself with ink and moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube stays Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
sections.At the table: The once-per-day Ink Cloud use returns when the squid finishes a Long Rest.

name: Hippopotamus
otherStatistics: Initiative -2 (8). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A round-bodied gray-brown hippopotamus with a broad muzzle, small ears and thick legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, 2024-rules Monster Manual p. 362, publisher stat block on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195076-hippopotamus
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack roll +7, reach 5 ft. Hit for 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

name: Hyena
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency Bonus +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A sandy spotted hyena with high shoulders, low hindquarters and rounded ears.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, 2024-rules Monster Manual p. 363, publisher stat block on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195085-hyena
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The hyena has Advantage on attacks against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally lacks the Incapacitated condition.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +2, reach 5 ft. Hit for 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

name: Jackal
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Darkvision 90 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A lean jackal with a pointed muzzle, tall triangular ears, russet flanks and a dark saddle.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, 2024-rules Monster Manual p. 364, publisher stat block on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195091-jackal
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +1, reach 5 ft. Hit for 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

name: Killer Whale
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Blindsight 120 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A black-and-white orca with a tall swept dorsal fin, rounded head and broad tail flukes.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, 2024-rules Monster Manual p. 364, publisher stat block on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195095-killer-whale
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The killer whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +6, reach 5 ft. Hit for 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage.
